hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that fully replaces Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity with its own pricing curve backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a configurable curve, moves input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to settle the trade entirely outside the standard pool mechanism.
